input:
Repo: Tendril (current directory). Contest: where a reminder lives. Main files are likely shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tendril/app/data/reminder/Reminder.kt, ReminderSpec.kt, ReminderOffset, and the alarm scheduling code.
Claims from the map:
1. Reminder(entryId, offset: ReminderOffset, anchorTime: LocalTime?) hangs off an Entry; the repeat rule lives on the Entry, not on the Reminder.
Claims about behaviour (verify each; list every Reminder column):
2. A reminder cannot exist without an Entry (non-null entryId, FK CASCADE).
3. ReminderOffset expresses 'N minutes/hours/days before' the Entry's start; anchorTime is for all-day or date-only items ('the day before at 09:00').
4. For a recurring Entry, each occurrence gets the reminder at the same offset.
5. A reminder can nag (repeat until acknowledged) or carry its own sound.
6. A task with no start time (date only) can still have a reminder.
7. There is no way to create a standalone reminder (a reminder with no task or event) anywhere in the UI.

Repo: Chronicle (current directory). Contest: where a reminder lives. Main files are likely data/src/main/kotlin/com/hazia/chronicle/data/room/entity/ReminderEntity.kt, the domain Reminder, core/data/.../remind/ReminderRepository.kt and the alarm code under app/.../alarm/.
Claims from the map:
1. ReminderEntity is standalone: dueAtIso, kind, repeatRuleKind, repeatIntervalMillis, nagEnabled, soundRef.
Claims about behaviour (verify each; list every column):
2. A reminder can optionally link to something else (a tracker, a goal, an activity, a checklist); say what, or that it links to nothing.
3. 'kind' distinguishes reminder types; list the values and what each changes.
4. Nag repeats the alert at an interval until acknowledged; say the interval and where it is set.
5. A reminder has status fields (done, notified, snoozed) separate from its schedule (ADR context: schedule and status are separate sync groups).
6. Snooze exists and moves dueAt, or is stored separately.
7. A reminder's text is its own title, not borrowed from a linked item.

Repo: Mnemo (current directory). Contest: where a reminder lives. Main files are likely app/src/main/kotlin/com/hazia/mnemo/data/local/Reminder.kt, ScheduleType, data/alarm/ and the repository.
Claims from the map:
1. Reminder is standalone, with ScheduleType ONE_SHOT | CRON | STOCHASTIC and a UUID id.
Claims about behaviour (verify each; list every Reminder column):
2. A reminder links to nothing else (no task, event or note id).
3. Nag/escalation exists (repeat until acknowledged); say how it is configured.
4. Snooze exists; say how it is stored.
5. 'Done' on a recurring reminder advances to the next fire; on a one-shot it archives the row.
6. nextFireAtEpochMillis is stored (precomputed), not derived at read time.
7. A reminder can have a time window (quiet hours / active hours) or per-reminder sound.
